name: hevy-fitatu
description: Your training (Hevy) and food diary (Fitatu) together, read-only: weekly load, sets per muscle, lift progress, intake on training vs rest days, protein per kg, and energy balance against your weight trend.

hevy_api_key.title: Hevy API key
hevy_api_key.description: Hevy Pro API key: Hevy app, Settings → Developer.

fitatu_email.title: Fitatu e-mail
fitatu_email.description: Your Fitatu login. Leave empty if you ran `fitatu-api login` (session in ~/.fitatu/session.json).

fitatu_password.title: Fitatu password
fitatu_password.description: Used once to log in; the session is then saved to ~/.fitatu/session.json.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone that decides which day a workout or meal falls on, e.g. Europe/Warsaw.
